# Trail

- Inherits [`Instance`](instance.md)
- Created with `Instance.new("Trail")`

Draws the ribbon that two attachments leave behind as they move: the swing of a sword, a tire mark, or the wake of something fast. Each piece of the trail lasts `Lifetime` seconds and fades as `Color`, `Transparency` and `WidthScale` set.

It is visual only: it is drawn every frame, it is not simulated, and a script cannot read where it is.

This page lists the members this class declares. Inherited members are
listed on the page of the class that declares them.

## Properties

| Name | Type | Default | Access | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Attachment0` | `Attachment?` | — | read/write | The attachment at one edge of the ribbon. |
| `Attachment1` | `Attachment?` | — | read/write | The attachment at the other edge of the ribbon. |
| `Color` | `ColorSequence` | `ColorSequence.new(Color3.new(1, 1, 1))` | read/write | The color of a piece over its life, from 0 when it is new to 1 at `Lifetime`. It is multiplied by the texture. |
| `Enabled` | `boolean` | `true` | read/write | Whether the trail grows. When it is off, the existing trail fades out over its `Lifetime`. |
| `FaceCamera` | `boolean` | `false` | read/write | Whether the ribbon turns about its center line to face the camera, as wide as the distance between the attachments. When it is off, the ribbon is the surface the two attachments swept. |
| `Lifetime` | `number` | `2` | read/write | How long a piece of the trail lasts, in seconds, from the moment the attachments were there. |
| `LightEmission` | `number` | `0` | read/write | How much the trail adds its color to what is behind it instead of covering it, from 0 (an ordinary surface) to 1 (pure light). |
| `LightInfluence` | `number` | `1` | read/write | How much the scene's lighting affects the trail's color, from 0 (always its own color) to 1 (lit like a surface). |
| `MaxLength` | `number` | `0` | read/write | The greatest length of the trail, in meters. Older pieces beyond it are removed. At 0, only `Lifetime` limits the trail. |
| `MinLength` | `number` | `0.1` | read/write | The distance the attachments must move before the trail gains a new piece, in meters. A smaller value is smoother and costs more. |
| `Texture` | `Content` | — | read/write | The image drawn along the trail, with U along its length and V across it. With no texture, the trail is a plain band of `Color`. |
| `TextureLength` | `number` | `1` | read/write | The length of one repeat of the texture, in meters, in the `Wrap` and `Static` texture modes. |
| `TextureMode` | `Enum.TextureMode` | `Enum.TextureMode.Stretch` | read/write | How the texture is laid along the trail. |
| `Transparency` | `NumberSequence` | `NumberSequence.new(0)` | read/write | How transparent a piece is over its life, from 0 (opaque) to 1 (invisible). |
| `WidthScale` | `NumberSequence` | `NumberSequence.new(1)` | read/write | The width of a piece over its life, as a fraction of the distance between the attachments. |

## Methods

### `Clear()`

Removes the whole trail at once. Call it when the object teleports, so the ribbon does not stretch from the old position to the new one.
